_comment: Generic MCP stdio server config. Adapt to your specific MCP client's config format.
_note: This is the universal config: it works unchanged on the host and inside a DevContainer because it contains no user-specific path. 'uv' must be resolvable on the MCP client's PATH. /opt/mempalace-mcp-bridge and /mempalace are runtime aliases created on the host by setup.sh (scripts/runtime_aliases.sh) and provided by bind mounts in a DevContainer.
